name: RHONEMA
recent: RHONEMA 近期持续进行股份回购，并出现董事 Dr Lim Ban Keong 在公开市场增持股份的权益披露。公司没有发布新的合约、业务或财报公告。
notable: 公司于2026年8月至11月期间多次进行股份回购。
集团董事总经理 Dr Lim Ban Keong 于2026年10月22日以每股 RM0.678 增持15,000股普通股。
risks: 董事 Dr Lim Ban Keong 在2026年10月22日于公开市场增持股份，导致其权益发生变化。

recent_en: RHONEMA has been continuously buying back its shares recently, alongside disclosures of director Dr Lim Ban Keong acquiring shares in the open market. No new contract, business, or financial results announcements were made.
notable_en: The company conducted multiple share buybacks between August and November 2026.
Group Managing Director Dr Lim Ban Keong acquired 15,000 ordinary shares at RM0.678 per share on 22 October 2026.
risks_en: Director Dr Lim Ban Keong increased his shareholding through an open market acquisition on 22 October 2026, resulting in a change in his interest.
